headline: What is HBM?
sub: High Bandwidth Memory, per the JEDEC HBM4 standard

cards.label: Stacked DRAM
cards.body: DRAM dies stacked 4 to 16 high, packaged next to the AI chip.

cards.label: Bandwidth
cards.body: HBM4: 2048-bit interface, up to 8 Gb/s, up to 2 TB/s per stack.

cards.label: Standard vs product
cards.body: Specs set the maximum. Actual products and timing vary by maker.
